FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Junior Research Fellow in the DST-
SERB Core Research Grant Project entitled “Development of new chemo-immunotherapy
approach for colorectal cancer” under the supervision of Prof. Kanwaljit Chopra (Principal
Investigator) and Dr. Sandip V. Pawar (Co- Principal Investigator), Assistant Professor, University
Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Essential Qualification:
1.B.Pharm and M.Pharm. (preferably in Pharmacology/Pharmaceutics/Pharmaceutical Biotechnology)
with minimum 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/PH)
2. GATE/GPAT qualified or any National entrance test exam conducted by any central Govt.
department is desirable.
3. Preference will be given to the candidates with industrial experience. Candidates having work
experience in Molecular Biology techniques, cancer research, mammalian cell culture and animal
handling will be preferred.
Fellowship:
Monthly emoluments of the fellowship shall be as per DST norms, the duration of the fellowship is for
the period of one year and can be extended further based on the performance of the candidate
Selection process:
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of Chairperson, UIPS,
Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Applications along with Curriculum Vitae may be submitted to the office of the undersigned by email
or sent by post latest by 31st October 2023. The date and time of the interview will be informed to the
shortlisted candidates by email. No separate interview letters will be issued and no TA/DA will be
provided for attending the interview. The position is purely on temporary basis and is coterminous with
the project.
Prof. Kanwaljit Chopra (PI) Dr. Sandip V. Pawar (CO-PI)
